## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits (`fix(client): ...`, `feat(statutes): ...`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and they pass locally
- [ ] Lint and type checks pass
- [ ] Generated files were regenerated from the spec, not edited by hand
- [ ] No API keys, tokens or customer data in code, tests, logs or screenshots
- [ ] Public behaviour changes are reflected in the README or docs
